Prepare, preview, schedule, and monitor email campaigns

positive.description: Use a dedicated Email Marketing review account. The contact claude@teleclaw.com may be added if absent.
positive.prompt: Add claude@teleclaw.com to my Email Marketing contacts with the first name Claude and company Teleclaw.
positive.expected_behavior: Call add_contact with email claude@teleclaw.com and fields containing the requested first name and company. Confirm the returned contact result. If the service reports that the contact already exists, explain that and do not claim a duplicate was added.

positive.description: Use the connected Email Marketing review account. A contact list named "MCP Review Contacts" may be created for this case.
positive.prompt: Create a contact list named "MCP Review Contacts" and add claude@teleclaw.com to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Create or identify the exact list name, then add claude@teleclaw.com using the returned list id. Confirm the list and contact membership only from tool results.

positive.description: Use the connected Email Marketing review account. The case creates a saved template.
positive.prompt: Create and save a friendly follow-up email template for claude@teleclaw.com named "MCP Review Follow-up". Use the merge tag {{First name}} and a concise subject.
positive.expected_behavior: Call generate_template with the requested name and a prompt that includes claude@teleclaw.com as context and preserves {{First name}} as a merge tag. Confirm the saved template and report the returned subject.

positive.description: The review account has a saved template named "MCP Review Follow-up".
positive.prompt: Show me the subject and body of the "MCP Review Follow-up" template prepared for claude@teleclaw.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the exact template using list_templates, then call get_template with its returned template id. Report only the subject and body returned by the tool; do not invent template content.

positive.description: The review account has a saved template named "MCP Review Follow-up". This is a dry run for one inline recipient and must not send or schedule email.
positive.prompt: Prepare a one-recipient dry run using the "MCP Review Follow-up" template for claude@teleclaw.com. Do not send or schedule the email.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the template, check quota for campaignSize 1, and call send_campaign only with dryRun true and source type manual containing exactly claude@teleclaw.com. Summarize the returned preview and quota. Do not claim an email was sent or scheduled.

negative.description: The connector does not search or read Gmail inbox messages. No Email Marketing tool should be used.
negative.prompt: Find the latest Gmail message from claude@teleclaw.com and summarize its contents.

negative.description: The connector sends campaigns through the connected Gmail account and does not operate Outlook mailboxes.
negative.prompt: Send an email campaign to claude@teleclaw.com from my Outlook account.

negative.description: The connector does not inspect Google Calendar availability or create calendar events.
negative.prompt: Schedule a Google Calendar meeting with claude@teleclaw.com for tomorrow.
